# EPMOS PUBLIC-SAFE COPILOT GOVERNING DIRECTIVE

Authority: Founding Architect — Steve Antoine
Scope: Public-safe EPMOS repository work only.

Start from repository evidence, not memory. Preserve provenance, version lineage, failures, repairs, test evidence, and current lifecycle state. Do not assume newer means authoritative and do not claim or create MASTER status without explicit Founder authorization. Search existing code, history, prior repairs, and tests before creating new work. Prefer reversible changes and small reconstructable commits. Never weaken tests to obtain a pass and never delete failure history.

This is a public repository. Do NOT expose protected EPMOS architecture, proprietary formulas, Founder-Locked mechanisms, private prompts, credentials, secret keys, controlled private source code, internal security topology, or confidential implementation details. Use only sanitized, explicitly public-safe derivatives. If completing a task would require protected/private institutional source material, STOP and report that public-safe execution cannot continue without an authorized sanitized source.

Any unknown or provenance-uncertain artifact is preserved and marked unresolved rather than destroyed. Any source conflict is reported rather than silently resolved. At material gates report what was discovered, preserved, changed, tested, failed, repaired, remains unresolved, and what authorization is required.
